Claid REST API v1 - the AI image editing, enhancement, generation and image-to-video API operated by Let's Enhance (Claid.ai). Covers synchronous and asynchronous image editing, batch processing, direct upload, AI edit by natural-language instruction, AI fashion models, AI background scene creation, image generation, image-to-video generation, and cloud storage connector management. Consolidated verbatim from the per-endpoint OpenAPI 3.1 definitions published in the Claid API reference at https://docs.claid.ai/.
